flags.description: Set when checkpoint 2 (platform announcement) is missed: we went to an empty platform first. Changes the scenes at checkpoints 6 and 7.

Set when checkpoint 4 (which ticket) is missed: we bought a ticket that is not the one for one journey home. The first barrier rejects us (it is the wrong gate), the guard says the ticket is fine (checkpoint 5 consequences) and the side-gate guard accepts it (checkpoint 8).
Set when checkpoint 5 or 8 (the guard) goes well: the guard remembers us. He reappears at the side gate (checkpoint 8) and waves from the platform in the made_it endings.
